signals.signal: Authority/epoch mismatch or stale write accepted
signals.response: Stop all tests/activation; separately authorized conditional target FROZEN; preserve evidence

signals.signal: Legacy business commit after fence proof/reconciliation
signals.response: Do not transfer TARGET; remain FROZEN and reconcile; Mode A invalid
Immediate acceptance abort and containment; keep Legacy fenced

signals.abortAt: 2 events within 60 seconds or one unresolved for 120 seconds
signals.response: Pause progression immediately; correlate request/log/metric; abort when threshold met

signals.abortAt: 3 unexpected failures within 60 seconds or one unresolved for 120 seconds
signals.response: Distinguish scheduled negative controls; stop writes until reconciled

signals.signal: Unexpected auth denial on a permitted persona
signals.response: Do not weaken authorization; stop acceptance
Preserve all state; freeze/reconcile under recovery authorization

signals.signal: Frontend uncaught error or unrelated domain network initialization
signals.response: Contain presentation with pinned rollback; target authority remains

signals.abortAt: 60 seconds without coverage or 5 minutes without expected correlated telemetry
signals.response: Hold before TARGET; after target require recovery/observation decision; never unattended completion

metrics: Accepted D1 namespaces/dimensions, detailed API routes, native Lambda/DynamoDB metrics, Core request/log correlation; expected denial/conflict probes are tagged in execution receipt rather than discounted globally
ingestion: Use request IDs and structured logs immediately; poll CloudWatch up to five minutes for expected count. Missing metrics never treated as zero. Preserve previous live D1 acceptance.
communication: Operator explicitly authorizes channel/start/extension/end communication later; no messages sent now
